text.description_html:
Deltana SDRP218 Round Pocket Door Passage Set

This round pocket door passage set has a contemporary look and comes complete with finger pull to pull the door from the pocket to close. It is easy to install in a standard pre-drilled door with a 2-3/8" backset and comes with all installation hardware. Normally used when a pre-drilled door is installed as a sliding pocket door and the door does not need to be locked. Available in polished chrome, satin nickel, or oil rubbed bronze finishes to complement any design. Adjustable to fit door thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches to 2 inches.

Passage Function (hall or closet): can be used on any single pocket door that does not need to lock such as on a closet door or in a hallway. It latches but does not lock.

Also available locking privacy function. Deltana Round Pocket Door Privacy Set.

Specifications for the Deltana Round Pocket Door Passage Lock

  • Door Prep: 2-1/8" face bore, 1" edge bore.
  • Finger Pull Prep: 1" bore
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" or 2"
  • Backset: 2-3/8"
  • Faceplate: 1" x 2-1/4" square corner
  • Strike: 1" x 2-5/8" square corner
  • Fasteners: M4 phillips drive
  • Packaged complete with all installation hardware.
  • SDRP218 Installation Instructions (PDF)
  • SDRP218 Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
